text:
mira.s: quick heads-up — incoming pen-test next Wed 09:00-13:00 UTC. need to confirm KMS read-only window and which ephemeral roles we'll open.

alex.k: flagged. can we limit to staging + canary? prod read-only only. also need audit logs retention snapshot for that window.

dimitri.r: staging + canary works. KMS: we'll create an ephemeral grant via kms-proxy for the assessor principal. TTL 4h?

mira.s: 4h OK but we need exact arn list and a runbook to revoke early if they escalate. can someone own the runbook? @sam.oncall?

sam.oncall: I can own runbook and on-call during window. will put pre-signed log export steps. also can add CloudTrail filter rule: resourceType = kms-key and api = Decrypt, GenerateDataKey.

taylor.security: also include RBAC snapshot: list of groups with access, timeboxed IAM policies. We'll require MFA on any console sessions.

jenna.reports: for report intake — please attach remediation tracker template. I'll ingest findings into our ticketing with severity + affected assets.

mira.s: copying the triage process: 1) report intake -> 2) triage (sec team + eng owner) -> 3) fix -> 4) evidence upload -> 5) retest slot. keep retest windows weekly for 4 weeks.

dimitri.r: question: for low-risk config notes, do we still require staging patch + prod-only advisory, or can we patch in staging and mark for future prod rollout?

taylor.security: low-risk can follow regular release cadence but must be noted in tracker with mitigations. anything exploitable in staging that maps to prod gets a hotfix label.

alex.k: on audit logging: we need to capture KV cache or model-serving logs? pentesters might hit inference endpoints. decide which logs to collect and redact PII.

mira.s: collect request headers + route + response size, but redact prompt text. add a safe-sampling policy to keep samples for 7 days.

sam.oncall: I'll add a lambda to copy logs to a readroom S3 prefix with encryption. note: S3 upload will need kms:Encrypt on our key, so include that in ephemeral policy.

pt-bot: PEN-TEST: Assessor "red-team-alpha" scheduled 2026-04-01T09:00Z. Uploaded assessor public key to handshake repo.

jenna.reports: received. I'll create ticket and assign triage owners. can we use label: pentest/2026-04?

mira.s: yes — use pentest/YYYY-MM. also add a field 'evidence_bucket' and 'kms_key_arn' in the tracker.

dimitri.r: for retest coordination: prefer Friday afternoons for quick slots. who will confirm retest availability with vendor?

alex.k: I'll confirm retest times and post a calendar invite. pls keep patches in a staging branch with commit hash recorded in ticket.

taylor.security: reminder: any KMS grants issued must be logged in audit and rotated. after window, we must rotate service-account keys used for the proxy (ephemeral creds).

sam.oncall: noted. I'll add a post-window checklist step: revoke grants, rotate proxy keys, export audit snapshot, close readroom access.

mira.s: ok owners: runbook/oncall = sam.oncall; triage intake = jenna.reports; RBAC snapshot = taylor.security; ephemeral grants = dimitri.r; retest coord = alex.k.

jenna.reports: uploading tracker now -> https://redwood-internal/triage/pentest-2026-04 (will add initial ticket ids).

mira.s: thanks all. final ask: if anyone sees an unexpected escalation during window ping @mira.s immediately and tag #incidents. :warning:

alex.k: got it. I'll post final checklist tomorrow and link runbook. :thumbsup:

sam.oncall: pre-window dry run tonight at 18:00 UTC — will test S3 copy + KMS proxy. join if you can.

dimitri.r: joining.

taylor.security: joining.

jenna.reports: will watch and note timing for evidence bucket creation.

mira.s: perfect — close loop after dry run. thanks everyone.
